name: Ankit Goyal
player_statement:
A complete player, Ankit Goyal has made a big mark in cricket. With 60 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 65, with an average of 26.81 and a quick strike rate of 142.12. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 74 sixes and 63 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 101.4 overs, taking 30 wickets at an economy rate of 9.60. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
